component.name: MainScene
component.script:
sub init() m.stack = [] m.screensGroup = m.top.findNode("screens") m.global.addFields({ session: {} }) showLogin() end sub
sub pushScreen(s as Object) top = m.stack.Peek() if top <> invalid then top.visible = false m.screensGroup.appendChild(s) m.stack.Push(s) s.callFunc("refocus") end sub
sub popScreen() cur = m.stack.Pop() if cur.hasField("closing") then cur.closing = true m.screensGroup.removeChild(cur) top = m.stack.Peek() if top <> invalid top.visible = true top.callFunc("refocus") end if end sub
sub resetStack() for each s in m.stack m.screensGroup.removeChild(s) end for m.stack = [] end sub
sub showLogin() s = CreateObject("roSGNode", "LoginScreen") s.observeField("loggedIn", "onLoggedIn") pushScreen(s) end sub
sub onLoggedIn() resetStack() h = CreateObject("roSGNode", "HomeScreen") h.observeField("selected", "onSelected") h.observeField("search", "onSearch") h.observeField("logout", "onLogout") pushScreen(h) end sub
sub onLogout() RegDel("server") RegDel("user") RegDel("pass") m.global.session = {} resetStack() showLogin() end sub
sub onSelected(event as Object) info = event.getData() if info.kind = "live" or info.kind = "ep" or info.direct = true startPlay(info) else d = CreateObject("roSGNode", "DetailScreen") d.observeField("play", "onPlay") d.info = info pushScreen(d) end if end sub
sub onPlay(event as Object) startPlay(event.getData()) end sub
sub startPlay(info as Object) p = CreateObject("roSGNode", "PlayerScreen") p.observeField("finished", "onPlayerEnded") pushScreen(p) p.info = info end sub
sub onPlayerEnded() if m.stack.Count() > 1 then popScreen() end sub
sub onSearch(event as Object) data = event.getData() s = CreateObject("roSGNode", "SearchScreen") s.observeField("picked", "onSelected") s.kind = data.kind s.items = data.items pushScreen(s) end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if press and key = "back" and m.stack.Count() > 1 popScreen() return true end if return false end function
